newsitem.title: GERMANY: West German inflation 0.3 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: West German inflation 0.3 pct in Dec.

text.p: Consumer prices in western Germany rose a provisional 0.3 percent in December from November to stand 1.4 percent above the levels of a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said Monday.
The data are based on preliminary figures from the four most populous states in western Germany, which began releasing figures last week.
Economists said inflation was slightly higher than expected and showed the effect of gains in prices for personal goods and services such as package holidays and hotel accomodations.
Trinkaus Capital Management forecast 1997 average inflation of 1.6 percent, but said this was still within the mid-term target of the Bundesbank central bank.
